playstyle: Keep-out and counter hits. Stand at mid range, make the opponent scared to press with his counter-hit launchers (b+1, f+3, 3+4, ws3, qcb+1), and punish hard. His backdash is poor, so control space with spacing and his long pokes rather than running away.

stances.name: Slither Step
stances.note: SLS.1+2 is a Heat Engager; SLS.2,4 and SLS.4,1,4 tornado. b+3 can enter it with f.

stances.name: Sway
stances.note: SWA.1 (qcb+1) is an i13 high that is +1 on block and launches on counter hit (+72a); it also wall-splats.

stances.name: Snake Eyes
stances.entry: 1+3+4, Heat, or moves like uf+3+4 on hit
stances.note: Wavu: Heat gives access to Snake Eyes moves.

keyMoves: Your fast punish; Wavu notes his i10-i13 punishes are middling.
His mid check and the start of df+2,1 (i13 punish).
i14 mid elbow, -2 on block, spikes.
A safe mid that spikes and can transition to crouch.
Close range when the opponent ducks.
Jet Uppercut: i14 tornado launcher, -7 on block.
His i14 launch punisher, safe on block.
His best punisher: practise the input until it is automatic.
After lows that are -15 or worse.
i12 while-standing knee, launches on counter hit.
A fast crouch punisher with a CH launch.
After -12 lows, or when they press.
Chopping Elbow: i20 mid, +4 on block, launches on counter hit (+78a).
His famous CH launcher that is plus on block.
At range when you expect the opponent to press or step in.
Do not press into it; sidestep or wait.
The heart of his keep-out game.
Knee Strike: i16 mid, +0 to +2 on block, launches on CH (+50a).
A safe, plus mid with a CH launch.
To keep the turn and punish presses.
Block it and do not press after.
Middle Side Kick: i18 mid, launches on counter hit (+59a).
At mid range against people who step in.
Knee Break: i16 mid, wall splat (Wavu).
An i16 punisher that splats at the wall.
Snake Edge: i29 homing low, launches (+70a), -26 on block.
As a read on standing block.
Mach Breaker: i13 high, Heat Engager, wall splat.
To whiff punish and start Heat.
Guillotine: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: Tornado BnB: 4,1 1 b+2,1~F SLS.2,4
combos.situation: After a tornado launch such as df+3 or a counter-hit qcb+1 (Wavu).
mistakes: Holding F too late after b+2,1: SLS has to start straight away.
Pressing 4,1 before the opponent has turned in the air.
